related.title: Google Cloud Audit Logs：資料存取可見性與保留量
related.titleEn: Google Cloud Audit Logs: data-access visibility and retention volume
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付24時段帳本、缺失與失敗分類、修改反例及驗證命令版本紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a twenty-four-period ledger, missing-versus-failed classification, modification counterexample and verifier-version record.
related.difference: 為每個服務標明所需稽核類型、實際設定、接收端、權限與保留期限，驗證資料存取的可見性。
related.differenceEn: Record required audit types, actual settings, destination, access rights and retention for each service, validating data-access visibility.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 完整性驗證覆蓋=已驗證時段/應有時段；雜湊相符不單獨證明來源身分或完整收集。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 24個小時應各有一份摘要；收到23份，其中22份連結與日誌驗證通過。 已驗證覆蓋22/24=91.6667%；缺1份與失敗1份需分開列。
保留量=每日事件×平均位元組×天數；這是未壓縮容量估算，不是供應商費用報價。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 每日合成資料存取事件200000筆，平均600byte，保留30天。 200000×600×30=3600000000byte，即3.6GB十進位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Integrity-validation coverage is verified periods divided by expected periods; matching hashes alone prove neither source identity nor complete collection. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty-four hourly digests are expected; twenty-three arrive, and twenty-two pass link and log validation. Verified coverage=22/24=91.6667%; distinguish one missing digest from one validation failure.

Retention volume equals daily events times average bytes times days; this is uncompressed sizing, not provider pricing. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Synthetic data-access volume is 200000 events per day averaging 600 bytes, retained for thirty days. 200000×600×30=3600000000 bytes, or 3.6 decimal GB.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST SP 800-61r3：分流、決策與事件交接
related.titleEn: NIST SP 800-61r3: triage, decisions and incident handoffs
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付24時段帳本、缺失與失敗分類、修改反例及驗證命令版本紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a twenty-four-period ledger, missing-versus-failed classification, modification counterexample and verifier-version record.
related.difference: 分開偵測、確認、範圍判斷與遏止決策，為每步保留時間、負責人、證據與未確定事項。
related.differenceEn: Separate detection, acknowledgment, scoping and containment decisions, recording time, owner, evidence and uncertainty.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

端到端回應時間是相鄰階段耗時之和；只縮短確認時間未必改善主要瓶頸。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成事件10:00偵測、10:08確認、10:23完成初步分流、10:50批准隔離。 各階段8、15、27分鐘，總計50分鐘；最長是決策交接27分鐘。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Integrity-validation coverage is verified periods divided by expected periods; matching hashes alone prove neither source identity nor complete collection. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Twenty-four hourly digests are expected; twenty-three arrive, and twenty-two pass link and log validation. Verified coverage=22/24=91.6667%; distinguish one missing digest from one validation failure.

End-to-end response time sums stage durations; faster acknowledgment may not fix the dominant bottleneck. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic event is detected at 10:00, acknowledged at 10:08, triaged at 10:23 and approved for isolation at 10:50. Stages take eight, fifteen and twenty-seven minutes, totaling fifty; decision handoff is longest.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
